When surveying an existing WLAN infrastructure for a possible redesign, you use two Wi-Fi USB adapters to collect RSSI data and two USB spectrum analysis adapters to collect RF spectrum data. Since your laptop doesn't have enough USB ports, you use a 4-port powered USB 3.0 hub. What issues could be caused by the use of USB 3.0 that will impact your site survey?
It does not give you enough bandwidth to collect data coming from all of the adapters.
It does not give you enough power for all four of your adapters.
It generates noise in the 2.4 GHz band, giving you a false perception of the noise floor.
It generates noise in the 5 GHz band, giving you a false perception of the noise floor.
C
USB 3.0 electronics and cabling can radiate noise in the 2.4 GHz band, artificially raising the measured noise floor during a survey.
What is the most cost-effective way to accurately measure the height of a ceiling when ladder use is not allowed?
Estimate the height based on known object sizes
Gather measurements from other objects and do the math
Rent a lift-cart to lift you up to the ceiling
Use a laser measure to measure the distance from the floor to the ceiling
D
A laser distance meter measures floor-to-ceiling distance directly without requiring ladder access.

You performed a site survey with two USB Wi-Fi adapters using a special driver written for the site survey software. After deployment, you realized that the client devices used by your customer are getting lower RSSI values than that shown during your site survey. What is the most likely reason for this result?
USB Wi-Fi adapters designed for site surveys may have better sensitivity than regular Wi-Fi cards installed in client devices.
The transmit power on the APs is higher than needed.
Regular Wi-Fi cards installed in client devices do not support the same protocols as survey adapters.
USB Wi-Fi adapters have a greater sensitivity than internal Wi-Fi adapters.
A
Survey adapters can have different antenna characteristics and receive sensitivity than production client devices, so survey RSSI may not match what end users experience.
When performing an active site survey in an existing WLAN infrastructure, in addition to gathering throughput data, what other important function will you typically be testing at the same time?
Application filtering
Internet bandwidth
Roaming
ACL configuration
C
Roaming performance depends on how quickly a client can move between APs and complete reassociation. Delays or interruptions are especially noticeable to voice applications.
Why should band steering algorithms allow stations to connect to the 2.4 GHz band after some number of ignored Probe Requests?
Because the FCC requires it.
Because some clients are persistent clients that will not move on to the 5 GHz band.
Because the 802.11 standard requires it.
Because the AP will experience a buffer overflow if they do not eventually respond with a Probe Response.
B
Some clients remain on 2.4 GHz despite steering attempts. A band-steering algorithm should eventually permit association rather than leave those clients unable to connect.
After designing a WLAN infrastructure using predictive design software. What's the best way to validate the predictive design in the physical space before deployment, if time and budget allow for it?
Deploy all of the APs as they're shown in the predictive design and perform an active site survey.
Deploy all of the APs as they're shown in the predictive design and perform a passive site survey.
Use a client device positioned where the APs will be installed and measure the signal from the client device.
Perform an AP-on-a-Stick survey using AP locations based upon the predictive design to confirm each AP's placement.
D
An AP-on-a-Stick survey temporarily places an AP at proposed locations and measures real propagation, validating or refining the predictive model before full deployment.

Your customer requires a security solution in which client credentials are used and the authentication server must have a certificate with optional client certificate use. Which EAP method would be the best fit for their requirement?
EAP-FAST
EAP-TTLS
EAP-TLS
LEAP
C
EAP-TLS uses mutual certificate authentication: both the authentication server and the client prove their identity with certificates.
Your customer requires fast secure roaming. Which two types of roaming are specified in 802.11- 2016 FT roaming that will help meet this goal?
Over-the-Air and Over-the-DS
Over-the-Air and Over-the-Wire
FT and OKC
FT and TKIP
A
802.11r Fast BSS Transition supports two exchange paths: over-the-air directly with the target AP, or over-the-DS through the distribution system.
What advantage provided by 802.11n and 802.11ac is not usable in 1X1:1 low-end client devices?
Channel bonding
MCS data rates
Maximal Ratio Combining
Mandatory data rates
C
MRC combines signals from multiple receive chains to improve the effective received signal and SNR; a 1x1 client cannot benefit from multiple receive chains.
When deploying APs outdoors, what additional component needs to be used that is not needed indoors?
Antennas
NEMA enclosures
Ethernet cables
PoE
B
Outdoor APs need appropriately rated environmental protection, such as a NEMA enclosure, when the AP itself is not rated for the installation conditions.
Which document provided to your customer should include all devices and parts that are going to be used during the deployment of their WLAN infrastructure?
SoW
BoM
Design report
Project plan
B
A bill of materials lists the equipment, components, quantities, and parts required for the deployment.
What limitation exists when WMM is not enabled on an 802.11n WLAN?
802.11 QoS will not be available
The maximum channel-width will be 20MHz
EDCA values will change
Only two ACs will be available
A
WMM is the Wi-Fi Alliance implementation of 802.11e QoS. Without WMM, the WLAN cannot provide the standardized wireless traffic-priority queues.
Using a SCA means that all APs will be using the same channel in a given layer. How is the AP with which the client associates determined?
All APs share a virtual IP address. A controller will tell the closest AP to the client to communicate with it, since it has a greater RSSI from the client.
All APs share a virtual Multicast Address. A controller will tell the closest AP to the client to communicate with it, since it has a greater RSSI from the client.
All APs share a virtual BSSID. A controller will tell the closest AP to the client to communicate with it, since it has a greater RSSI from the client.
The client selects the AP based on a known set of MAC to BSSID mappings stored in the clients authorized SSID listing.
A

In a single-channel architecture, APs share a common virtual identity and the controller directs the client to the AP that hears it best. The closest/strongest AP is selected using the reported signal measurements.
What service must be implemented on your customers' network to authenticate users against an LDAP database prior to access to the WLAN infrastructure being granted?
NTP
RADIUS
SFTP
TLS
B
RADIUS provides centralized AAA between the WLAN authenticator and the authentication service; it can validate users against a connected identity store such as LDAP.
What is the best method of gathering attenuation measurements from any building materials or objects?

After measuring the RSSI in free space 5 meters (16.5 feet) apart, put an AP 4 meters (13 feet) away from the wall or object on one side and your measuring device 0.67 meters (2 feet) away from the wall or object on the other side. Take measurement and compare the difference.
Use the pre-built attenuation values in the predictive design tool.
After measuring the RSSI in free space 1 meter (3 feet) apart, put an AP 0.32 meters (1 feet) away from the wall or object on the other side. Take measurements and compare the difference.
Look on the Internet for attenuation values for each one of the materials that might attenuate the Wi-Fi signal using the material provider's websites.
A
Measure a free-space baseline at a controlled distance, then repeat with the material in the path. The difference estimates that material's attenuation.
Which type of authentication and encryption method is mandatory for Voice Enterprise certified devices as specified by the Wi-Fi Alliance?
WPA2/AES Personal
WPA2/TKIP Enterprise
WPA2/AES Enterprise
WPA/TKIP Personal
C
Wi-Fi Alliance Voice Enterprise certification requires enterprise authentication with AES-based encryption, providing per-user authentication and strong link protection.
What document should be created that provides instructions for install technicians to mount and configure APs?
Hold Harmless
Statement of Work
Bill of Materials
Physical installation guide
D
A physical installation guide translates the RF design into actionable mounting locations, methods, cabling, and configuration instructions for installers.
In addition to a copy of your design, which tools should you use to ensure the installation team deploys APs where you have them designed to be located?
GPS and a map
RF spectrum analyzer and packet capturing software
Ladder and a pen
Camera and marking tools
D
A camera records actual installation conditions, while marking tools help installers identify the exact AP mounting points shown in the design.
When installing APs on high ceilings, what should be the most common PPE to be used?
Hardhat, high visibility vest and body belt
Glasses, gloves and jacket
Clean suits, masks and glasses
Clean suits, gloves and jacket
A
Use the required head protection and high-visibility clothing for overhead installation work, together with the site's approved fall-protection equipment.
You're preparing to perform a site survey for a company that processes meat. Some areas are restricted due to high-security. What do you have to do in order to proceed with the site survey?
Gain appropriate access and clearance to perform the site survey.
Gain meat processing access certification from the FDA.
Ensure that you and your team are using food industry approved USB adapters for the survey.
Just begin the survey, they will understand
A
Obtain the required site access and security clearance before entering restricted areas. A survey must follow the customer's safety and access controls.
